### Building the Reminder Scheduler

First, I'll create a `ReminderScheduler` struct that handles the actual scheduling of local notifications. This involves using `UNUserNotificationCenter`.

```swift
// src/notifications/scheduler.swift
import UserNotifications

public struct ReminderScheduler {
    public func requestAuthorizationIfNeeded() async -> Bool {
        return await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            UNUserNotificationCenter.current().requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .sound]) { granted, _ in
                continuation.resume(returning: granted)
            }
        }
    }

    public func rescheduleForTomorrow(dueCount: Int, at time: DateComponents) async {
        let content = UNMutableNotificationContent()
        content.title = "Daily Reminder"
        content.body = "You have \(dueCount) cards due today."

        var dateComponents = Calendar.current.dateComponents([.year, .month, .day], from: Date())
        dateComponents.hour = time.hour
        dateComponents.minute = time.minute

        let trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger(dateMatching: dateComponents, repeats: false)
        let request = UNNotificationRequest(identifier: "dailyReminder", content: content, trigger: trigger)

        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            UNUserNotificationCenter.current().add(request) { error in
                if let error = error {
                    print("Failed to schedule notification: \(error)")
                }
                continuation.resume()
            }
        }
    }

    public func cancelPending() async {
        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            UNUserNotificationCenter.current().removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: ["dailyReminder"])
            continuation.resume()
        }
    }
}
```
